CHEMISTRY — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #7
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: CHEMISTRY
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Milk souring
   B. Iron rusting
   C. Paper burning to ash
   D. Ice melting to water

2. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 100 °C
   B. 37 °C
   C. 50 °C
   D. 0 °C

3. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   B. Movement of water only across a membrane
   C. Heating until a solid melts
   D. A chemical reaction forming ash

4. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water always increases oxygen
   B. Petrol fires have no fuel
   C. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   D. Water removes heat too quickly

5. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Removing all vegetation
   B. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   C. Burning crop residue every week
   D. Overgrazing continuously

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Industrial manufacture of inorganic chemicals ● Ammonia - The Haber Process. (ra? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Industrial manufacture of inorganic chemicals ● Ammonia - The Haber Process. (ra.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Industrial manufacture of inorganic chemicals ● Ammonia - The Haber Process. (ra.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Industrial manufacture of inorganic chemicals ● Ammonia - The Haber Process. (ra.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Industrial manufacture of inorganic chemicals ● Ammonia - The Haber Process. (ra.

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Electrochemistry 2.3 Nuclear chemistry 3.0 Organic Chemistry 3.1 Alkanols 3.2 Al? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Electrochemistry 2.3 Nuclear chemistry 3.0 Organic Chemistry 3.1 Alkanols 3.2 Al.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Electrochemistry 2.3 Nuclear chemistry 3.0 Organic Chemistry 3.1 Alkanols 3.2 Al.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Electrochemistry 2.3 Nuclear chemistry 3.0 Organic Chemistry 3.1 Alkanols 3.2 Al.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Electrochemistry 2.3 Nuclear chemistry 3.0 Organic Chemistry 3.1 Alkanols 3.2 Al.

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Energy Changes in physical and chemical processes ● System and surrounding ● Ene? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Energy Changes in physical and chemical processes ● System and surrounding ● Ene.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Energy Changes in physical and chemical processes ● System and surrounding ● Ene.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Energy Changes in physical and chemical processes ● System and surrounding ● Ene.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Energy Changes in physical and chemical processes ● System and surrounding ● Ene.

9. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   B. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   C. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   D. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Energy Changes in physical and chemical processes 2.2. Electrochemistry 2.3 Nucl? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Energy Changes in physical and chemical processes 2.2. Electrochemistry 2.3 Nucl.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Energy Changes in physical and chemical processes 2.2. Electrochemistry 2.3 Nucl.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Energy Changes in physical and chemical processes 2.2. Electrochemistry 2.3 Nucl.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Energy Changes in physical and chemical processes 2.2. Electrochemistry 2.3 Nucl.

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Detergents ● Types of detergents ● Preparation of detergents ● Mode of action of? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Detergents ● Types of detergents ● Preparation of detergents ● Mode of action of.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Detergents ● Types of detergents ● Preparation of detergents ● Mode of action of.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Detergents ● Types of detergents ● Preparation of detergents ● Mode of action of.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Detergents ● Types of detergents ● Preparation of detergents ● Mode of action of.

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Carbon and extraction of metals ● Occurrence of carbon (allotropes of carbon-dia? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Carbon and extraction of metals ● Occurrence of carbon (allotropes of carbon-dia.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Carbon and extraction of metals ● Occurrence of carbon (allotropes of carbon-dia.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Carbon and extraction of metals ● Occurrence of carbon (allotropes of carbon-dia.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Carbon and extraction of metals ● Occurrence of carbon (allotropes of carbon-dia.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Energy Changes in physical and chemical processes ● System and surrounding ● Ene and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Electrochemistry 2.3 Nuclear chemistry 3.0 Organic Chemistry 3.1 Alkanols 3.2 Al and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Electrochemistry ● Redox reactions ● Electrochemical cell ● Standard electrode p and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Nuclear Chemistry ● Stability of isotopes ● Chemical and nuclear reactions ● Rad and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
